WC requires at least: 8.9
WC tested up to: 8.9

An internally impossible listing: it demands a WordPress the package says it
never ran against.

== Description ==

This is the mistake a raised minimum leaves behind. Somebody moves "Requires at
least" up because an older WordPress no longer works, and forgets that "Tested
up to" is a separate line; the listing then promises support for a range whose
floor is above its ceiling. The directory publishes it unchanged, and every
reader of the page is being told two things that cannot both be true.

Only the WordPress pair is broken here. The WooCommerce pair and the two
minimums agree with the plugin header and Constants, so a report naming anything
else would be the gate finding what is not there.
